description: This is a Java interface defining methods related to reading guarantor and obligee data associated with loan accounts in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: GuarantorReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface specifying methods to retrieve guarantor and obligee data for loans.

methods.name: retrieveGuarantorsForValidLoan
methods.description: Validates the provided loan ID and retrieves associated guarantors.

methods.name: retrieveGuarantorsForLoan
methods.description: Retrieves all guarantors for a given loan ID if the loan is valid.

methods.name: retrieveGuarantor
methods.description: Retrieves a specific guarantor's data based on loan ID and guarantor ID.

methods.name: retrieveObligeeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves obligee details for a specific client ID.
